# Parley v0.1.21

This test beta fixes the idle CPU regression, adds person-controlled
automatic approval and clean close for agent command runs, brings the in-app
Help up to date and continues the ad-hoc, unnotarized test-beta channel. It is
the first release cut from the GitLab pipeline on a self-hosted macOS runner
and the first published as a GitLab release.

## Performance

- Closing Status Center, Task Manager, Settings, Help or About now releases
  the window's content. Previously SwiftUI kept the closed window's view tree
  alive, so its timers, live labels and a segmented-control layout loop kept
  running: a live sample of v0.1.20 with those windows closed showed the main
  thread 99% busy and the app at 80–100% of a core. Minimising a window or
  hiding the application suspends it instead, keeping unapplied drafts.
- Terminal title changes are applied in memory and persisted at most once a
  second by a coalesced write; a title change no longer runs persistence plus a
  full model refresh. Pane attention is projected once per input generation,
  the Status Center history is filtered in a single pass, and Task Manager
  sampling runs on one serial owner off the main actor.
- The activity journal appends one synced line per record with a committed
  boundary, repairs an uncertain tail on load and compacts under retention.
- The one-second relay tick asks the in-process broker for a change revision
  first and skips its five control-socket round trips when nothing changed,
  with a forced refresh every fifteen ticks. The agent file transport polls
  every 50 ms while requests flow and backs off to 250 ms when quiet, woken at
  once by a directory watcher, so an idle app neither scans inboxes twenty
  times a second nor delays an agent's request.
- Measured on the shipped configuration after these changes: main thread
  98.5–98.7% idle with the auxiliary windows closed, 0–8% CPU over a working
  day, against 80–100% before.

## Agent command runs

- Settings > General > Agent command runs adds two switches, both off by
  default and both stored in Parley's private application directory where
  agent processes cannot read or write them.
- **Approve agent command runs automatically** approves every eligible
  `parley request-run` exactly as requested and starts it in a new Shell pane
  without a preview. Turning it off restores per-run approval at once and
  returns any automatic approval that has not started to waiting. Each run
  records that it was approved automatically.
- **Close the Shell pane when a run finishes cleanly** ends the run's pane
  after a clean result instead of handing it to an interactive shell, then
  removes the pane and returns focus to where you were. Failed, cancelled or
  truncated runs keep their pane with an ordinary shell. Parley never closes
  a pane running an interactive shell.
- The agent protocol describes both switches; live panes show RESTART FOR
  PROTOCOL until restarted (protocol v23).

## Help and housekeeping

- Help gains topics for Settings and appearance, Requested command runs and
  Team sessions, an automatic-updates section, navigation shortcuts from the
  real menu bindings, a runnable recovery path from a SwiftPM sandbox error to
  a recovered request-run result, and Prepare to Uninstall.
- The embedded Ghostty wrapper moves to libghostty-spm 1.5.20260906 (Ghostty
  1.3.2-dev at c4e16970).
- Lifecycle mutations in the workbench refuse to begin while a surface is
  being terminated, closing a re-entrancy hazard in restart, stop and close.
